integrity: Analytic proof from a complete orthogonal Laplacian eigenspace decomposition and exactly one positive zero per critical quartic. Independent exact-rational checks reproduce the orbit entry identities; enumeration is not the universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite simple unweighted one-hub clique sums, completed [2/2] Gauss endpoint only; no assertion about weighted or arbitrary block graphs, or nonnegative internal stages. Originality comparison is finite.
title: Sharp Gauss–Padé positivity on heterogeneous one-hub clique sums
